k:衰.mnemonic: A fine garment (衣) with one (一) patch sewn across the middle, then a patch on the patch. The family's fortunes show in the cloth getting thinner every year. Decline (wane, weaken).
k:衰.hint: A fine robe, patched and thinning.

k:轄.mnemonic: A wedge pinned through the axle keeps the wheel on the car (車) and stops it doing harm (害). Whoever holds the pin decides where the car goes. Control (wedge).

k:劣.mnemonic: Few (少) muscles and little power (力): the smallest one on the team, always the last to be picked. Inferiority (be inferior to, be worse).

k:寂.mnemonic: Uncle (叔) lives by himself under a big roof (宀). The house has been silent ever since everyone moved away. Loneliness (quietly, mellow, mature).
k:寂.hint: One man in a big silent house.

k:疫.mnemonic: A sickbed (疒) in every house. The illness sweeps through the town like a weapon (殳), striking street after street. Epidemic.

k:綿.mnemonic: White (白) fluff picked from the plant, spun into thread (糸), and woven into the softest towel (巾) you own. Cotton.

k:桑.mnemonic: A tree (木) with a hand reaching into it, and also (又) another, and also another: three pickers stripping leaves to feed the silkworms. Mulberry.

k:拶.mnemonic: Evening (夕) is falling and the stream (巛) is rising. Fingers (扌) grip the bank as the water creeps up to them: any moment now. Be imminent (draw close).

k:賠.mnemonic: The member (員) who broke the clubhouse window has to stand (立) before everyone with his purse open and pay for the glass. Compensation (indemnify).

k:浸.mnemonic: The tsunami (氵) rises past your forehead (冖). The broom (ヨ) is under water, and also (又) the hand that was holding it. Immersed (soak, dip, steep).

k:蛇.mnemonic: Something long drops from the roof (宀) beams. It is no insect (虫), though it creeps like one, and its head is as flat as a spoon (匕). Snake (serpent, hard drinker).
k:蛇.hint: Flat head dropping from the rafters.

k:徐.mnemonic: A stroll (彳) through the grain (禾). There is no need to arrive right now (今), so you go one easy step at a time. Gradually (slowly, deliberately, gently).

k:涼.mnemonic: In the hot capital (京), people sit by the river at dusk, where each splash like a tiny tsunami (氵) freshens the air. Cool (refreshing, nice and cool).
k:涼.hint: City folk by the river at dusk.

k:幽.mnemonic: A tiny (幺) hermit and his tiny fire, hidden deep in a pit (凵) between the peaks where no visitor will ever find them. Seclude (confine to a room, deep, profound).

k:挨.mnemonic: Pay (払) the archer on the wall and he lowers his arrow (矢). Now you may walk up to the gate. Approach (draw near, push open).
k:挨.hint: The archer lets you come up.

k:靴.mnemonic: The leader (亻) has a piece of leather (革) cut and stitched so that it changes into something he can walk in. Shoes.

k:晶.mnemonic: Day (日) upon day upon day: three suns stacked together, a light so bright that it glitters like a cut gemstone. Clear (sparkle, crystal).

k:乏.mnemonic: A long stride (廴) down to the river with nothing but a bent fishhook (乙): no bait, no line, and it is all he owns. Destitution (scarce, limited).
k:乏.hint: Only a bent hook to his name.

k:緩.mnemonic: The family lineage (系) is drawn as a taut cord. A claw (爪) lets go at one end, a hand also (又) eases off at the other, and the cord sags. Slacken (loosen, relax, lessen).
k:緩.hint: Both ends ease and it sags.

k:椅.mnemonic: A tree (木) that has grown into a strange (奇) shape: four legs, a flat seat and a back. You may as well sit down. Chair.
k:椅.hint: Trunk with four legs and a back.

k:貯.mnemonic: Shellfish (貝) money is hidden up under the roof (宀) beams, in the box where the tool (具) kit is kept, and a little more goes in every month. Savings (store, lay in, keep).

k:奨.mnemonic: The commander (将) climbs onto something big (大) so that every soldier can see him, and shouts to them to give it their all. Exhort (urge, encourage).
k:奨.hint: Shouting to the troops from on high.

k:嵐.mnemonic: Wind (風) roaring down off the mountain (山), flattening the crops and tearing the shutters from the houses below. Storm (tempest).

k:朱.mnemonic: A stick (｜) of red ink makes two (二) strokes, then a slide (ノ) of the brush, and fins (ハ) flick out at the bottom. This is the red seal that makes your stocks (株) official. Vermilion (cinnabar, scarlet, red).
k:朱.hint: The red seal on the certificate.

k:葛.mnemonic: A vine with purple flowers (艹). Dig up the root, soak it for a decameron (旬) of ten days, and you get a starch to stir into soup by the spoon (匕). Arrowroot (kudzu).
k:葛.hint: A vine's root soaked for starch.

k:陵.mnemonic: A great mound (阝) of soil (土) heaped over an emperor. The legs (儿) of visitors trudge (夂) slowly up its steps to pay their respects. Mausoleum (imperial tomb, mound, hill).

k:逸.mnemonic: With some excuse (免), he slips off the path (辶) that everyone else is walking and wanders away into the grass like a runaway rabbit. Deviate (idleness, leisure, miss the mark).
k:逸.hint: Slipping off the road like a rabbit.

k:溶.mnemonic: The block of ice cannot contain (容) itself in the sun. It runs off across the table as a tiny tsunami (氵). Melt (dissolve, thaw).

k:侯.mnemonic: A leader (亻) whose arrow (矢) hangs on the wall by its handle (ユ). He no longer shoots: he owns the land and the archers too. Marquis (lord, master, owner).
k:侯.hint: His bow days are behind him.

k:悠.mnemonic: The leader (亻) will trudge (夂) on with a calm heart (心) and no hurry at all. The road has always been there and always will be. Permanence (distant, long time, leisure).
k:悠.hint: A calm walker on an endless road.
